entry.title: Coffee Break: Armed Madhouse – Algeria and Gaza Parallels
entry.summary: Military dominance is often treated as strategic insurance. Yet history suggests that battlefield superiority can generate domestic political instability when the moral and reputational costs of sustained force penetrate the patron state’s political system.
